defs.def: a possibility of sth happening, especially sth that you want （尤指希望发生的事的）可能性

ex.s: Chances are that if you’re looking to live a more sustainable lifestyle, not everyone around you will be ready to jump on that bandwagon.
ex.t: 很可能，如果你想过上更可持续的生活，你周围并非所有人都会准备好跟上这股潮流。

ex.s: Chances are the cost will be a lot less than the cost of one bedroom.
ex.t: 很可能费用会比一间卧室的花费少得多。

ex.s: The more we know about this lovely creature, the greater the chance it will survive and keep its place in the natural world for a long time to come.
ex.t: 我们对这种可爱的生物了解得越多，它就越有可能生存下来，并在未来很长一段时间内保持其在自然界的地位。

ex.s: The researchers found that the dogs were able to pick the angry or happy face by touching a picture of it with their noses more often than one would expect by random chance.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，狗能够通过用鼻子触碰图片来选择愤怒或快乐的面孔，其正确率高于随机概率。

defs.def: a suitable time or situation when you have the opportunity to do sth 机会；机遇；时机

ex.s: "To us, the most likely explanation appears to be that the basis lies in their living with humans, which gives them a lot of exposure to human facial expressions," and this exposure has provided them with many chances to learn to distinguish between them, Muller said.
ex.t: “对我们来说，最可能的解释似乎是，基础在于它们与人类生活在一起，这让它们有大量机会接触人类面部表情，”Muller说，而这种接触为它们提供了许多学习区分它们的机会。

ex.s: After sharing the story online， I heard from someone，who（7）     the lady as Erin Smith． Without（8）     ，I called to thank her． She said she （9）     my wallet on a bus seat． She （10）     that going to a stranger's house was a（11）      move， but she decided to take the chance． "If I were in that（12）     ． I would want someone to try to find me，"she said．

ex.s: A child born in the US today has   63   very realistic chance of living beyond 100 and needs to plan accordingly.
ex.t: 今天在美国出生的孩子有___63___非常现实的机会活过100岁，因此需要相应地规划。

ex.s: But Cobb and others ____38____ （be） now questioning that idea pushing conferences to provide more chances to participate remotely, and ____39____（change） their personal behavior to do their part in dealing with the climate change crisis.
ex.t: 但Cobb和其他人现在____38____ （be）开始质疑这种观点，推动会议提供更多远程参与的机会，并____39____（change）改变个人行为，为应对气候变化危机尽自己的一份力。

ex.s: Alistair had to choose -brotherly love, or a chance to win the race?
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔必须选择——兄弟之情，还是赢得比赛的机会？

ex.s: It is an annual series of triathlon events, and athletes compete for a chance to be World Champion.
ex.t: 这是一年一度的铁人三项系列赛，运动员争夺成为世界冠军的机会。

ex.s: Cooking together gives us a chance to relax and catch up on each other’s days.
ex.t: 一起做饭给了我们放松、聊聊彼此近况的机会。

ex.s: Traditionally, it was a chance to give thanks for a good harvest.
ex.t: 传统上，这是一个感谢丰收的机会。

ex.s: “They were the best chance for many rural people to get the treatment they want. ”
ex.t: “它们是许多农村人获得他们想要的治疗的最佳机会。”

ex.s: She has chances to see rare animals.
ex.t: 她有机会看到稀有动物。

ex.s: “We see it as a chance to try to break the growing disconnect between people and nature.”
ex.t: 我们把它看作一个机会，试图打破人与大自然之间日益加深的疏离。

ex.s: It also gives people a chance to see what the new home looks like.
ex.t: 这也让人们有机会看看新家是什么样子。

ex.s: You may have chances to meet new people who'll become your lifelong friends.
ex.t: 根据你选择的角色，你可以帮助增加社区获取安全饮用水的机会，或帮助保护珍贵的本地文化。

ex.s: Growing up, my family and our neighbors never used clotheslines to dry clothing, denying me the chance ____62____ (discover) one of the great wonders of sunshine — the sweet “sunshine scent” after sunning clothes for an entire day.
ex.t: 成长过程中，我家和邻居从不使用晾衣绳晾衣服，使我失去了____62____（发现）阳光的一大奇迹的机会——把衣服晒上一整天后那甜美的“阳光味”。

ex.s: It's a chance not to be missed.
ex.t: 这是个不容错过的机会。

ex.s: She did not have a chance to go to ____24____.
ex.t: 她没有机会去上___24____。

ex.s: And in contrast to our increasingly networked lives where the information we consume is monitored and tracked, a printed book still offers the chance of a wholly private, “off-line” activity.
ex.t: 与我们日益网络化的生活——我们所消费的信息被监控和追踪——形成对比的是，印刷书仍提供一种完全私密、"离线"活动的机会。

ex.s: I jumped at the chance, and a few weeks later I was equally shocked—and overjoyed—when she invited me to talk with her about potential projects I could pursue in her lab.
ex.t: 我毫不犹豫地抓住了这个机会，几周后，当她邀请我与她讨论我可以在她的实验室里开展的潜在项目时，我同样震惊——而且欣喜若狂。

ex.s: If you are close to the front of the list, you have a good chance of gaining a place in the programme in the near future.
ex.t: 如果你排在名单靠前位置，你很有机会在近期获得该项目的一个名额。

ex.s: Everyone has a chance to succeed in their pursuit.
ex.t: 每个人都有机会在追求中取得成功。

ex.s: Her chance of promotion.
ex.t: 晋升的机会。

ex.s: Our tour also includes a chance to walk in the footsteps of Van Gogh and Gauguin.
ex.t: 我们的行程还包括追随Van Gogh和高更的脚步漫步的机会。

ex.s: “it seemed like the perfect chance for natural selection to act on a population," said Dr Ilardo.
ex.t: “这似乎是自然选择作用于一个种群的绝佳机会，”伊拉尔多博士说。

ex.s: The party is a chance for friends and family to congratulate the person on the new home.
ex.t: 36   这也是用爱和希望填满新空间的好时机——当然还有礼物。

ex.s: But once having met and liked them, we think how terrible it would have been, had we missed the chance.
ex.t: 但一旦我们遇到并喜欢上他们，我们就会想，如果错过了这个机会该有多糟糕。

ex.s: “It's a chance for self-reflection, You return to work recharged and with a plan.”
ex.t: “这是一次自我反省的机会，你重返工作时会充满活力，并且带着计划。”

ex.s: There is no other chance like a GDA programme.
ex.t: 没有其他机会像GDA项目这样。

ex.s: Lipan Apache in the United States (two or three) or Wadjigu in Australia (one, with a question-mark): none of these seems to have much chance of survival.
ex.t: 美国的利潘阿帕奇语（两三个人）或澳大利亚的瓦吉古语（一人，带问号）：这些似乎都没有多大存活机会。

ex.s: The arrival of driverless vehicles is a chance to make sure that those vehicles are environmentally friendly and more shared.
ex.t: 无人驾驶汽车的到来，是确保这些车辆环保且更共享的机会。

ex.s: The coming technological advancement presents a chance for cities and states to develop transportation systems designed to move more people, and more affordably.
ex.t: 即将到来的技术进步为城市和各州提供了发展交通系统的机会,这些交通系统旨在以更廉价的方式迁移更多的人。

ex.s: Experts say Paris is right: For a sudden heart failure, the single best chance for survival is having someone nearby step in and do CPR quickly.
ex.t: 专家们说巴黎的做法是对的：对于突发性心脏骤停，唯一的最佳生存机会是有人就近挺身而出并迅速实施心肺复苏术。

ex.s: That’s why students do better in tests if they get a chance to sleep after learning.
ex.t: 这就是为什么学生在学习后如果有机会睡一觉，考试会考得更好。

ex.s: Not standing a chance against competitive applicants, I came out of the interview with an upset look.
ex.t: 面对竞争的申请者,我没有机会,我从面试中走出来时,表情很沮丧。

ex.s: The woman has less chance to get the job than others.
ex.t: 这位女士得到这份工作的机会比别人小。

ex.s: The Aviation Challenge program gives trainees the chance to earn their Aviation badge.
ex.t: 航空挑战计划让学员有机会获得航空徽章.

defs.def: an unpleasant or dangerous possibility 风险；冒险

ex.s: Oh, Gosh…I thought they were being awfully quiet.” We were never actually left behind in a strange city, but we weren’t about to take any chances.
ex.t: “噢，天哪……我以为他们安静得反常。”我们其实从没有被丢在陌生的城市，但我们不打算冒任何风险。

ex.s: chances to meet the experts in person
ex.t: 对疫苗的抵抗已经持续了几十年，它的驱动力是一个真实但非常小的风险。

defs.def: the way that some things happen without any cause that you can see or understand 偶然；碰巧；意外

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

ex.s: Later, when English ships encountered violent storms in the China Sea, Englishmen learned the Cantonese word tai fung, which means “great wind.” The word's ___39___ to touffon is only by chance.
ex.t: 后来,当英国船只在中国海遭遇暴风雨时,英国人学会了广东话的tai fug,意思是“大风 ” 。 这个单词的  39  到touffon只是偶然的。

ex.s: I don't know what made me decide to try some new activities at the new school, but one day I chanced to show up for an after-school meeting of the Science Olympiad team.
ex.t: 我不知道是什么让我决定在新学校尝试一些新活动，但有一天我碰巧去参加了科学奥林匹克队的一次课后会议。

ex.s: His reply came as a surprise — a shock, actually: “Not a chance.” Clearly, he was unhappy over the way we had parted.
ex.t: 他的回复令人意外——其实是震惊：“绝不可能。”显然，他对我们分开时的方式感到不快。

ex.s: Resolving arguments can improve your emotional health，because it increases your reactivity and reduces the chance of you getting angry．
ex.t: 解决争论可以改善你的情绪健康因为它增加了你的反应性并减少了你生气的几率．

defs.def: to risk sth, although you know the result may not be successful 冒险；拿 … 去冒风险
to happen or to do sth by chance 偶然发生；碰巧

ex.s: Every Saturday I begged Mom not to make me go to the swim meet, but had little chance of success.

ex.t: 在纽约这样一个多元文化的城市，像我这样的学生有幸能与多样化的人群一起工作。
